property_summary: Only owner can successfully call AdjustDifficulty, so when a non-owner invokes AdjustDifficulty it must revert.

If this test contract is not the owner (cannot call onlyOwner functions), then attempts by it to call AdjustDifficulty must revert; equivalently, AdjustDifficulty should only succeed when this contract is owner.
If this contract cannot call owner-only functions (i.e., transferAnyERC20Token would revert), then its attempt to call AdjustDifficulty must also have reverted (transferReverted || reverted).

For any caller and any uint256 passed to AdjustBetAmounts, only the contract owner can change betLimit while difficulty remains unchanged; the mutant that removes onlyOwner can let a non-owner call AdjustBetAmounts and (via changed call sequence) cause difficulty to differ afterward for some inputs.
